metadata.article_title: Prohibition of arrest or detention of women in execution of decree for money.

article.title: Prohibition of arrest or detention of women in execution of decree for money.
article.content:
56Prohibition of arrest or detention of women in execution of decree for money.

Section 56
Arrest and detention
Notwithstanding anything in this Part, the Court shall not order the arrest or detention in the civil prison of a woman in execution of a decree for the payment of money.
